qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Sticky UK commercial/SME deposit relationships (1 in 5 SMEs) and retail current accounts (~16.5% share) provide substantial low-cost funding and pricing power; demonstrated by resilient RoTE of 15-16%.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 5, REJECT). Domestically concentrated UK retail and commercial bank (~16.5% current accounts, 1 in 5 SMEs). Lacks secular reinvestment runway outside mature UK economy, with structural profitability highly sensitive to BoE interest rate cuts, mortgage price competition, and fintech disintermediation.
qualitative.evidence: NatWest Group generates strong returns in peak-rate environments (RoTE 15-16% in 2024-2025 supported by structural hedges), holding £730B+ in group assets and 12.5% of UK mortgages. However, complete domestic UK concentration leaves earnings power exposed to UK economic cyclicality, rate cycle downturns, and challenger bank fee erosion, limiting predictable runway to 5 years (CAP = 5).
